hotel.name: Bellustar Tokyo, A Pan Pacific Hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 1-29-1 Kabukicho, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Address: 1-29-1 Kabukicho, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo 1600021, Japan

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a 1 minute walk from Seibu Shinjuku Station.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 1 minute walk from Seibu Shinjuku Station.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a 7-minute walk from Shinjuku Station.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 7-minute walk from Shinjuku Station

verified_facts.text: Japanese culture is woven into the interiors of the guest rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Japanese culture is woven into the interiors of guest rooms

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have windows seven meters wide offering a panorama of Tokyo.
verified_facts.excerpt: while windows seven meters wide offer an amazing panorama of Tokyo spread out before you.

verified_facts.text: The Sky Private Villa on the topmost floors features a restaurant three levels tall with views.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Sky Private Villa on the topmost floors features a restaurant three levels tall that offers stunning views

verified_facts.text: The spa, SPA sunya, is on the hotel's highest floor and is named after the Sanskrit term sunya, meaning sky.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Sky Spa is situated on the hotel's highest floor and named after the Sanskrit term "sunya" for "sky

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments have a seasonal feel and incorporate natural ingredients from all over Japan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Personal treatment infused with a seasonal feel incorporating natural ingredients from all over Japan

verified_facts.text: The spa has treatment rooms and a relaxing lounge area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enter any of the treatment rooms or the relaxing lounge area

verified_facts.text: The penthouses sit at an altitude of 200 meters.
verified_facts.excerpt: Five penthouses stretching across a celestial "Tenku" scape that seem to melt into the sky amidst the dynamism of a 200-meter altitude.

verified_facts.text: The penthouses take their names from the Ten in Tenku and the elements of Kacho Fugetsu: Flowers, Birds, Wind and Moon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Taking their names from the "Ten" in Tenku (celestial sky-scape) and each element of the term "Kacho Fugetsu" (Flowers, Birds, Wind, and Moon)

verified_facts.text: The penthouse floor is furnished with Karimoku Case furniture with design work by Keiji Ashizawa and Norm Architects.
verified_facts.excerpt: The entire floor is furnished with Karimoku Case furniture with design work by Keiji Ashizawa and Norm Architects

verified_facts.text: Penthouse Sora is the largest of the penthouses and the hotel's flagship suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: The largest of the five penthouses and the flagship suite of Bellustar Tokyo

verified_facts.text: Penthouse Sora has east-facing windows that let in the morning sun.
verified_facts.excerpt: dazzles with the light from the morning sun that streams in through all its east-facing windows

verified_facts.text: In the maisonette-style Penthouse Tori, the bedrooms and living room are on different floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: the bedrooms and living room are situated on different floors for flexibility and privacy

verified_facts.text: Restaurant Bellustar serves interpretations of French tradition using ingredients from various regions of Japan.
verified_facts.excerpt: our chefs deliver exquisite interpretations of French tradition while showcasing ingredients sourced from various regions of Japan

verified_facts.text: Bar Bellustar combines city views, innovative cocktails and immersive performances.
verified_facts.excerpt: combining breathtaking city views, innovative cocktails and immersive performances

verified_facts.text: At Teppan Ten-yu, chefs prepare a customised menu of Japanese ingredients in front of guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: our skilled chefs prepare a customised menu of exquisite Japanese ingredients in front of you

verified_facts.text: Sushi JIN-E prepares nigiri with rice seasoned with a secret vinegar recipe.
verified_facts.excerpt: each nigiri is expertly crafted by our master chef with rice seasoned with a secret vinegar recipe

verified_facts.text: The restaurant and bar sit 200 meters above ground with panoramic views.
verified_facts.excerpt: while you soak in the breath-taking panoramic vista at an impressive 200 meters above ground

verified_facts.text: Guests arriving by car park in the Tokyu Kabukicho Tower car park.
verified_facts.excerpt: If you arrive by car, please park in the Tokyu Kabukicho Tower car park.

verified_facts.text: Check-in assistance is given by staff on the 1st floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Any member of staff on the 1st floor will be glad to assist you with checking in.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's Sakura Upcycle Project made fans with threads dyed using cherry blossoms from hotel decorations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fans with threads dyed using cherry blossoms from hotel decorations
